description: Elections Commission - Direction to Prevent the Misuse to Movable or Immovable Properties belonging to the State, State Corporations or Statutory Boards during the Period of an Election
reasoning: This gazette contains directions issued by the Election Commission regarding the conduct of elections, specifically prohibiting the misuse of state property during election periods to promote or prejudice any party, group, or candidate. It addresses electoral processes, conduct during elections, and the responsibilities of public officials in relation to election activities, making it clearly fall under the Elections category.
